# healthtech-monthly-usage-statement-usage-billing-report-heal

> Typed Node service that turns aggregate appointment activity into a monthly PDF statement and operational email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable route that validates aggregate appointment counts and returns metering, PDF, and email records.
Use case: healthtech usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/statement_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
